chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa' from Aban from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The major sins are seven: among them is killing the soul deliberately, and associating partners with Allah the Magnificent, and slandering the chaste woman, and consuming usury after clear proof, and fleeing from the battle, and adopting pre-Islamic practices after emigration, and disobedience to the parents, and consuming the wealth of the orphan unjustly.' He said: 'And adopting pre-Islamic practices and shirk are one (same).'
ai.seo_question: What are the seven major sins according to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the canonical list of seven major sins, with Al-Kulayni noting the scholarly nuance that 'al-Ta'arrub' (adopting pre-Islamic customs) is synonymous with 'Shirk' in this specific enumeration. This classification underscores the gravity of these sins in Shia jurisprudence, linking ritual purity directly to social and ethical conduct, particularly regarding family rights and wealth.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The major sins are seven. From these is – killing the soul deliberately, and the association with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Magnificent, and slandering the married woman, and consuming the interest (please change all) after the clarification, and fleeing from the battle-field, and adopting the pre-Islamic practices before the emigration (Hijra), and disloyalty to the parents, and consuming the wealth of the orphan unjustly’. 
And the adoption of the pre-Islamic practices and the association (Shirk), is one (same)’.
en.sarwar: 14. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla ibn Muhammad from al- Washsha’ from Aban from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘The major sins are seven: One of them is murdering a soul intentionally, considering things as a partner of Allah the Most Great, accusing a married women of committing an indecent act, consuming unlawful interest in trade with evidence, mnning away from the battlefield during an offensive against the enemy, alienation from religion after accepting it, disregarding to maintain good relations with parents and consuming the property of orphans unjustly.’ The Imam said, ‘Alienation and paganism are the same.’”
